تعضوا (form I)
# تَعَضُّوا (taʕaḍḍū) /ta.ʕadˤ.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of عَضَّ (ʕaḍḍa)
# تُعَضُّوا (tuʕaḍḍū) /tu.ʕadˤ.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of عَضَّ (ʕaḍḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
